commands.command:
set -eu
git fetch origin work/ux-evolution
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/work/ux-evolution)"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo "SOURCE_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
echo 'WAIT_SAFE_LOAD'
READY=0
for n in $(seq 1 24);do
 LOAD="$(python3 -c 'import os;print("%.1f"%os.getloadavg()[0])')"
 echo "LOAD:$n:$LOAD"
 if python3 -c "raise SystemExit(0 if float('$LOAD') < 14 else 1)";then READY=1;break;fi
 sleep 10
done
test "$READY" -eq 1
echo 'CANONICAL_VISUAL_E2E'
set +e
LCL_E2E_PORT=5297 LCL_VISUAL_CONTRACT=1 pnpm exec playwright test -c apps/mobile/playwright.config.ts --workers=1 --reporter=json >/tmp/shelly-ionic-20261011-194-e2e.json 2>/tmp/shelly-ionic-20261011-194-e2e.err
RESULT=$?
set -e
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
s=Path('/tmp/shelly-ionic-20261011-194-e2e.json').read_text(errors='replace')
try:
 j=json.loads(s[s.find('{'):]);stats=j['stats'];print('E2E_STATS',stats)
 def walk(ss):
  for suite in ss:
   for sp in suite.get('specs',[]):
    for t in sp.get('tests',[]):
     if t.get('status') not in ('expected','skipped'):
      print('E2E_FAILURE',sp.get('title'),t.get('status'))
      for run in t.get('results',[]):
       if run.get('error'): print('ERROR',(run['error'].get('message') or '')[:1300])
   walk(suite.get('suites',[]))
 walk(j.get('suites',[]))
except Exception as e:print('E2E_PARSE_FAILURE',str(e),s[-1600:])
PY
echo "E2E_COMMAND_EXIT=$RESULT"
tail -15 /tmp/shelly-ionic-20261011-194-e2e.err || true
echo 'WORKTREE';git status --short
test "$RESULT" -eq 0
